description: Six stereo core frames, the fourth with an FSIZE that reaches 256 bytes into the fifth.
findings: cut short by the next frame's sync word

crosscheck.decode_note: ffmpeg decodes the damaged frame without an error: the frame's silent subframes take a few dozen of its bytes, the rest is padding that no decoder reads, and a core frame without CRC words (CPF 0) has no other check of its own

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser keeps the damaged bytes in the packets around them.
skip.libdca: libdca's tool reads frames by their sizes, so the frame with the large FSIZE swallows the next one.
